diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted 18 h reading was 1.1612. Independent reads of the retained 18 h aliquot gave means of 0.599 at 2-fold dilution, 0.2389 at 5-fold, and 0.1184 at 10-fold. Multiplying by the respective dilution factors gives proportional-response estimates of 1.198, 1.1945, and 1.184 OD, closely agreeing with one another and with the undiluted reading (about 1.19 versus 1.16). Thus there is no evidence for substantial hidden biomass from reader under-response at the endpoint; the small difference is not compelling evidence of a meaningful elevation. The hourly undiluted readings likewise plateau near 1.15–1.19 in the final hours.

response.instructions:
You are an autonomous scientist working in a virtual microbiology laboratory.

A bacterial batch culture was inoculated at t = 0 h and incubated for 18 h. Its
optical density at 600 nm (OD600) was read every hour on a plate reader, and an
aliquot of the culture was withdrawn and retained every hour. The hourly readings
are provided in the first message.

Your task is to decide whether, over the final hours of the experiment, the
culture's biomass is at the level the undiluted readings indicate, or higher than
the undiluted readings indicate, and to support your conclusion with evidence.

You may request additional measurements with measure_od; each replicate reading
costs 1 unit from a budget of 6 units. Finish by calling submit_diagnosis. You have
at most 12 turns.

tools.description: Analyse a retained aliquot of the culture on the OD600 plate reader. Aliquots were withdrawn and retained every hour from 0 to 18 h; withdrawing them did not affect the culture. The aliquot from the requested hour is diluted in sterile medium by the given factor (1 = undiluted; 10 = 1 part aliquot + 9 parts medium) and read. Each replicate is an independent dilution and read, and costs 1 budget unit. Returns the blank-subtracted OD600 reading of each replicate exactly as read; no correction is applied.
tools.name: measure_od

dilution_factor.description: Total dilution factor applied before reading: from 1 (undiluted) to 100.

replicates.description: Number of independent replicate reads: 1, 2 or 3.

time_h.description: Hour at which the aliquot was withdrawn: an integer from 0 to 18.

tools.description: Optional. Record your current notes and your current probability that, over the final hours, the culture's biomass is higher than the undiluted readings indicate. Free of charge; never required.
tools.name: declare_state

notes.description: Free-text notes on your current thinking.

p_biomass_above_reading.description: Probability from 0 to 1 that, over the final hours, biomass is higher than the undiluted readings indicate.
